messages.Clear removes the photo’s stored history: Clear removes the photo’s stored history steps; it is not an adjustment-reset command.

messages.Clear this photo’s stored history steps;: Clear this photo’s stored history steps; keep its current edits

messages.Click Apply previewed changes. If you ch: Click Apply previewed changes. If you change the selection or correction controls, preview again first.
messages.Click Apply to commit the preset to the: Click Apply to commit the preset to the active photo. Use Undo in the details or the Undo action in the completion message to restore the previous edit.
messages.Click Back up now and check for a Verifi: Click Back up now and check for a Verified backup result.

messages.Click Continue. The app proceeds after t: Click Continue. The app proceeds after the choice is saved.
messages.Click Create collection or the + beside: Click Create collection or the + beside Collections, enter a name, and save. The current selection is included.
messages.Click Done or press Enter to accept. Cli: Click Done or press Enter to accept. Click Cancel or press Escape to restore the frame from when you opened Crop.
messages.Click Edit and wait for rendering to fin: Click Edit and wait for rendering to finish before working in the other app.
messages.Click Export and follow the progress in: Click Export and follow the progress in the top bar.
messages.Click Filter beside Sort and use Color l: Click Filter beside Sort and use Color label to find a particular colour, any colour, or unlabelled photos.
messages.Click Filter beside Sort. Select one or: Click Filter beside Sort. Select one or more file types, then combine them with Flag, Rating, Color label, or Edit status.
messages.Click Import after reviewing compatibili: Click Import after reviewing compatibility, then read the report and matched, not found, and skipped counts. LightTable creates a catalog backup before a trial or import.
messages.Click Measure to inspect the comparison,: Click Measure to inspect the comparison, or Starting match to apply an initial adjustment.
messages.Click Open submission form, attach the p: Click Open submission form, attach the package and any permitted additional examples, and add your creator details, description, and publishing permissions before submitting.

messages.Click Preview selection and review the b: Click Preview selection and review the before-and-after times and any skipped photos.
messages.Click Refresh to check the catalog. When: Click Refresh to check the catalog. When a newer version is listed, Update in Yours replaces the saved recipe only when you choose it.
messages.Click Sample color under Point Color, th: Click Sample color under Point Color, then click a colorful patch in the photo.
messages.Click Scan. Use Previous and Next to rev: Click Scan. Use Previous and Next to review every page, and check the selected count and destination preview before clicking Import. Import is unavailable when no photos are selected.
messages.Click Search photos and keywords, or pre: Click Search photos and keywords, or press / when you are not typing in a field.

messages.Click a spot or drag over a distraction: Click a spot or drag over a distraction in the photo.
messages.Click a star or press 1–5 to rate. Press: Click a star or press 1–5 to rate. Press 0 to clear the rating.
messages.Click a step to restore its settings. Re: Click a step to restore its settings. Restoring a step is itself an undoable edit.

messages.Click selects a single active photo. Shi: Click selects a single active photo. Shift-click selects a contiguous range. Command-click on Mac or Control-click adds or removes individual photos.
messages.Click snap slider to view at the top rig: Click snap slider to view at the top right of the photo area to center the divider in the current view. This also brings an offscreen divider back after panning, without changing your zoom or pan.
messages.Click the adjustment slider you want to: Click the adjustment slider you want to map, then turn a knob or move a fader.
messages.Click the eyedropper again to leave samp: Click the eyedropper again to leave sampling mode without choosing a point.
messages.Click the graph to add a point, then dra: Click the graph to add a point, then drag it to shape the curve. Drag an existing handle to move it.
messages.Click the snapshot’s name to apply it la: Click the snapshot’s name to apply it later. Use Undo if you want to return to the state you just replaced.
messages.Click the star beside a folder, or open: Click the star beside a folder, or open its ••• menu and choose Add as Favorite.
messages.Click the white-balance eyedropper besid: Click the white-balance eyedropper beside Temp, then click an area in the photo that should be neutral gray.
messages.Click the ✦ beside Collections, labelled: Click the ✦ beside Collections, labelled Save filters as smart collection.
messages.Click × on a cell to remove it from the: Click × on a cell to remove it from the survey without deleting or rejecting it. Double-click a cell to open that photo in Detail.
messages.Close Lightroom Classic, then choose its: Close Lightroom Classic, then choose its
messages.Color Grading in Edit provides separate: Color Grading in Edit provides separate Shadows, Midtones, and Highlights selections, plus a global grade. Each has Hue, Saturation, and Luminance controls.
messages.Color Mixer sits inside Edit → Color. It: Color Mixer sits inside Edit → Color. It changes colors within the selected band throughout the photo.
messages.Color grade shadows, midtones, and highl: Color grade shadows, midtones, and highlights
messages.Color sampling: waiting for image previe: Color sampling: waiting for image preview…
messages.Color’s Reset also resets its associated: Color’s Reset also resets its associated color adjustments, including Color Mixer, Point Color, and Color Grading. Use a tool’s own Reset for a narrower change.
messages.Colour labels are yours to assign meanin: Colour labels are yours to assign meaning to—for example, red for retouching or green for delivery. They do not change star ratings or pick/reject status.
messages.Combine a sequence of distinct originals: Combine a sequence of distinct originals into a new 16-bit TIFF, then edit the merged result.
messages.Command/Ctrl+Shift+E opens Export; Comma: Command/Ctrl+Shift+E opens Export; Command/Ctrl+E opens external editing. Text fields keep ordinary typing behavior, so leave a text field before using unmodified editing shortcuts.
messages.Community is offline. Built-in and saved: Community is offline. Built-in and saved presets remain available.
messages.Community publication is reviewed. The s: Community publication is reviewed. The submission section shows the exact Develop and Film settings in the prepared look, its Film behavior, and the photo corrections it keeps. Nothing is uploaded when inspecting this summary or preparing a download.
messages.Compare your result with the original us: Compare your result with the original using the before control, or hold B while the photo is active.
messages.Complete edits travel in .lighttable-sta: Complete edits travel in .lighttable-state.json when you copy the folder.

messages.Consecutive look applications use the ed: Consecutive look applications use the edit from before the first look, so settings from one look do not accumulate into the next. A later manual edit starts a new comparison baseline. If you change photos or edit settings while a detail is open, select the preset again before applying.

messages.Control grain relative to the stock and: Control grain relative to the stock and choose the simulated film size.

messages.Copy and Paste transfer the groups you e: Copy and Paste transfer the groups you explicitly select. Settings in unchecked groups stay as they are on each destination. This is an explicit copy/paste workflow: later edits to the source do not automatically synchronize to the destinations.

messages.Dehaze changes the image’s haze-like ton: Dehaze changes the image’s haze-like tonal and color treatment. Vignette changes edge brightness: positive values darken the edges and negative values brighten them.
messages.Delete all Remove, Heal, and Clone corre: Delete all Remove, Heal, and Clone corrections from this photo
messages.Delete all masks and their local adjustm: Delete all masks and their local adjustments from this photo
messages.Delete index removes generated index dat: Delete index removes generated index data after confirmation. Originals and saved edits are unchanged. messages.Delete the generated local photo index?: Delete the generated local photo index? Your originals and edits will not be changed.
messages.Delete virtual copy in Photo actions rem: Delete virtual copy in Photo actions removes the active virtual copy. For a real second file on disk, export a rendered image.

messages.Depth runs from far to near. Embedded ca: Depth runs from far to near. Embedded capture depth is used when available; otherwise LightTable estimates locally.
messages.Depth uses embedded capture depth when a: Depth uses embedded capture depth when available, otherwise a local estimate. Estimated depth is relative and can be inaccurate.
messages.Descriptions, objects, scenes, text, and: Descriptions, objects, scenes, text, and faces
messages.Detail controls work in both Film and De: Detail controls work in both Film and Develop modes. Avoid judging sharpening from a small Fit preview alone.
messages.Detection produced an invalid mask; exis: Detection produced an invalid mask; existing masks were preserved
messages.Develop Defaults apply only to photos th: Develop Defaults apply only to photos that do not already have saved edits. They can start Film enabled, choose a workflow and neutral Develop profile, and apply a default preset.
messages.Develop mode — editing the neutral sourc: Develop mode — editing the neutral source
messages.Develop settings are approximate and can: Develop settings are approximate and cannot promise Lightroom’s rendered appearance. Unsupported local masks, camera profiles, .lrcat-data AI masks or LUT payloads, and unsupported smart-collection rules are reported as skipped. Imported develop settings turn Film off.
messages.Development appears only when the chosen: Development appears only when the chosen film profile supplies development times. Print development depends on the selected paper and is hidden for slide film. Development contrast is a separate film control.
messages.Dim chrome and panels around the current: Dim chrome and panels around the current photo. Press L to toggle.
messages.Direct transparency scan · no print stag: Direct transparency scan · no print stage

messages.Double-click an interior point to remove: Double-click an interior point to remove it. The two endpoint handles remain.
messages.Download this photo in Finder, then resc: Download this photo in Finder, then rescan the source.
messages.Drag a handle to resize the crop; the ph: Drag a handle to resize the crop; the photo zooms to keep the frame centred. Drag inside the frame to move the photo under it, or outside it to draw a new crop.
messages.Drag either on-image circle to refine th: Drag either on-image circle to refine the target or source.
messages.Drag on the photo to change the selected: Drag on the photo to change the selected gradient’s shape or position
messages.Drag on the photo to edit the {tool} mas: Drag on the photo to edit the {tool} mask.
messages.Drag the handles to resize; the photo zo: Drag the handles to resize; the photo zooms to keep the frame centred. Drag inside the frame to move the photo under it, or outside it to draw a new crop. Arrow keys nudge the crop; hold Shift for larger steps. Enter accepts; Escape restores the frame from when you opened Crop.
messages.Drag the target circle to reposition the: Drag the target circle to reposition the correction, or choose Move Target and click its new position.
messages.Each new backup includes a contents mani: Each new backup includes a contents manifest and checksum, and is reopened independently to verify it.
messages.Edit a photo in another application: Edit a photo in another application
messages.Edit status offers Edited, Unedited, and: Edit status offers Edited, Unedited, and Virtual copies. A virtual copy uses its original file’s type. Press Escape or click outside the panel to close it without clearing your choices.
messages.Edit the combined RGB tone curve: Edit the combined RGB tone curve
messages.Edit the copy. Use Filter → Edit status: Edit the copy. Use Filter → Edit status → Virtual copies to find copies later.
messages.Editing controls are unavailable until a: Editing controls are unavailable until a photo is loaded. Adjustments are stored as edit settings for the photo. The editor saves changes automatically as you finish interactions; you do not need a separate Save command for each adjustment.
messages.Edits could not be saved. Use Retry save: Edits could not be saved. Use Retry save before continuing.
messages.Edits save automatically. Check the save: Edits save automatically. Check the save status, retry a failed save, or choose which edits to recover after reopening.
messages.Edits saved; local recovery still needs: Edits saved; local recovery still needs attention
messages.Effects’ Vignette is a creative edge tre: Effects’ Vignette is a creative edge treatment. Use Lens corrections when you want to correct lens shading.
messages.Enable Colour range, then click Sample c: Enable Colour range, then click Sample colour and sample a colorful point, or hold Shift and drag over an area to average it.
messages.Enable Grain size and adjust its slider,: Enable Grain size and adjust its slider, or clear its checkbox to disable grain.
messages.Enable Photo Index in Settings and wait: Enable Photo Index in Settings and wait for photos to be scored.
messages.Enable Use matched lens profile when a p: Enable Use matched lens profile when a profile is available, then choose Correct distortion and Correct lens shading as needed.
messages.Enable temporarily switches a mask’s eff: Enable temporarily switches a mask’s effect off or on. Invert reverses its selection.
messages.Enable the index to create searchable me: Enable the index to create searchable metadata.
messages.Enable the photo index in Settings to cr: Enable the photo index in Settings to create searchable metadata.
messages.Enhance needs the macOS inference helper: Enhance needs the macOS inference helper; there is no build for {platform} yet
messages.Enhance output is model-generated detail: Enhance output is model-generated detail, not measured detail. The denoise model may be bundled; any model used is identified in this manifest. Super-resolution remains unavailable unless installed separately.
messages.Enhancement can generate detail; evaluat: Enhancement can generate detail; evaluate the output before treating it as a faithful record of fine texture.
messages.Enter Shift clock by hours, such as -1 o: Enter Shift clock by hours, such as -1 or 5.5.
messages.Enter a Template such as {custom}_{seque: Enter a Template such as {custom}_{sequence}. Set Custom text and Start at as needed.

messages.Enter one or more keywords, then choose: Enter one or more keywords, then choose Add to selection or Remove from selection. Each photo keeps its other keywords.
messages.Every export embeds the selected ICC pro: Every export embeds the selected ICC profile. Choose sRGB, Display P3, or ProPhoto RGB in Colour space.
messages.Every step, kept with the photo: Every step, kept with the photo

messages.Expand Assisted culling in the library s: Expand Assisted culling in the library sidebar.
messages.Expand Camera, exposure & date in Filter: Expand Camera, exposure & date in Filter. Camera and Lens match part of a name. Keyword matches a complete catalog keyword path and its descendants; for example, Places includes Places > Boston.
messages.Expand Capture & processing to choose As: Expand Capture & processing to choose As shot, Daylight, Tungsten, or Custom capture white balance for a RAW photo.
messages.Expand Capture & processing to choose Pa: Expand Capture & processing to choose Paper and any available Print development time.
messages.Expand Color Grading and select Shadows,: Expand Color Grading and select Shadows, Midtones, or Highlights.
messages.Expand Detail in Edit. Adjust noise redu: Expand Detail in Edit. Adjust noise reduction and sharpening while looking at both textured and smooth areas.
messages.Expand Effects in Edit. Texture changes: Expand Effects in Edit. Texture changes fine local detail, while Clarity applies local contrast with greater emphasis on midtones. Positive values strengthen these effects; negative values soften them.
messages.Expand Lens corrections in Edit. The pro: Expand Lens corrections in Edit. The profile card explains the automatic camera/lens match and whether a usable profile is available.
messages.Expand Perspective and try Auto upright,: Expand Perspective and try Auto upright, or adjust Vertical, Horizontal, and Scale manually.
messages.Expand Range for the selected mask and a: Expand Range for the selected mask and adjust Luminance Low and Luminance High while checking the overlay.
messages.Expand Reference Match and choose a Refe: Expand Reference Match and choose a Reference image.
messages.Export creates rendered output files fro: Export creates rendered output files from your photo edits. Use Selected photos when you want the export limited to a specific selection.
messages.Export → Advanced offers All except loca: Export → Advanced offers All except location, All metadata, Copyright only, and No metadata. The initial metadata choice is All except location.
messages.Exports and Trash use the files you choo: Exports and Trash use the files you choose or include in the current view. They do not automatically include a hidden companion. Choose Both files and review the selection when you need both originals. Capture-time correction has its own Include RAW + JPEG companions checkbox.
messages.Exposure accepts fractions such as 1/250: Exposure accepts fractions such as 1/250. Set both limits to the same value for an exact match.
messages.Exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows: Exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows and master curve
messages.Exposure, white balance and photo correc: Exposure, white balance and photo corrections are kept.
messages.External XMP changes conflict with pendi: External XMP changes conflict with pending edits ({properties}). Read the sidecar metadata before syncing again.
messages.Favorite a folder to keep it close at ha: Favorite a folder to keep it close at hand.
messages.Featured is an editorial collection, not: Featured is an editorial collection, not a popularity ranking.
messages.File timestamp can use the time of expor: File timestamp can use the time of export or the original capture time. If capture timezone is missing, the default is to keep export time and report a warning. You can instead choose to interpret it in this computer’s local timezone.
messages.Filename templates support {filename}, {: Filename templates support {filename}, {stock}, {date}, {rating}, and {sequence}. For example, {filename}_{stock} includes the source name and film stock.
messages.Files & Metadata controls portable Light: Files & Metadata controls portable LightTable edits beside originals, automatic XMP writing, RAW/JPEG pairing, and keyword entry. Complete portable edits use .lighttable-state.json; XMP carries compatible edits and metadata. XMP sync preserves unrelated fields and reports conflicting external changes; read Exchange metadata through XMP sidecars for the supported workflow.
messages.Fill a distraction using surrounding ima: Fill a distraction using surrounding image detail
messages.Film applies a modeled film and output p: Film applies a modeled film and output process to a still photo. The Film profile switch controls this processing; your Edit adjustments remain active when you switch Film off.
messages.Film format sets the physical long edge: Film format sets the physical long edge used by the simulation. The choices are 35 mm, 645, 6 × 6, 6 × 7, and 4 × 5; this setting is separate from cropping the photo.
messages.Film mode — physical film processing on: Film mode — physical film processing on
messages.Film on enables the included film treatm: Film on enables the included film treatment. Film off bypasses Film. Film unchanged leaves its enabled state alone. A film treatment may intentionally change Camera EV, automatic metering, development, print, grain, and other creative film controls.
messages.Film processing is bypassed. Edit adjust: Film processing is bypassed. Edit adjustments remain active.
messages.Film {mode}. Keeps exposure, white balan: Film {mode}. Keeps exposure, white balance, crop and photo corrections.
messages.Filter camera, exposure, and capture dat: Filter camera, exposure, and capture date
messages.Find photos with search, filters, and so: Find photos with search, filters, and sorting
messages.Find shortcuts, choose a keyboard scheme: Find shortcuts, choose a keyboard scheme, and map a hardware controller where Web MIDI is available.
messages.Find, try, and share editing presets: Find, try, and share editing presets
messages.Finish saving your edits before generati: Finish saving your edits before generating masks
messages.Finish saving your edits before undoing: Finish saving your edits before undoing the batch
messages.Fit the whole photo to the available spa: Fit the whole photo to the available space
messages.Flags and ratings apply to selection: Flags and ratings apply to selection
messages.Flags and stars are separate: a photo ca: Flags and stars are separate: a photo can be Picked and have any star rating. Reject marks a photo for review; it does not delete it.
messages.Focus stack accepts 2–60 focus-bracketed: Focus stack accepts 2–60 focus-bracketed photos with matching dimensions. Use a tripod or focus-rail sequence with shared framing. The app aligns the frames, combines sharp regions, and crops to their common aligned area.
messages.Folder actions are available in the Ligh: Folder actions are available in the LightTable desktop app
messages.Follow the newest arrival when I am not: Follow the newest arrival when I am not culling
messages.For Brush, choose Size, Feather, and Flo: For Brush, choose Size, Feather, and Flow, then paint over the photo. For Linear or Radial, drag on the photo to set the shape.
messages.For Custom, adjust Temperature and Captu: For Custom, adjust Temperature and Capture tint.
messages.For Focus stack, inspect transitions bet: For Focus stack, inspect transitions between sharp regions, foreground edges, and the final crop at 1:1.
messages.For HDR, inspect highlights, shadows, an: For HDR, inspect highlights, shadows, and anything that moved between exposures.
messages.For Heal or Clone, drag the source circl: For Heal or Clone, drag the source circle to a better area. Refresh Source tries a different source position.
messages.For Panorama, inspect seams and the oute: For Panorama, inspect seams and the outer boundary, then crop the result as needed.
messages.For Soften skin, review the automaticall: For Soften skin, review the automatically applied Texture and Clarity reduction, then adjust it to suit the portrait.
messages.For a damaged catalog, Library Health ma: For a damaged catalog, Library Health may offer salvage, restore, or a fresh catalog. Salvage copies readable rows but loses rows on damaged pages. Starting fresh does not carry over ratings, edits, collections, or history. The current damaged catalog file is preserved in Recovery.
messages.For a localized treatment, use a mask’s: For a localized treatment, use a mask’s Texture and Clarity controls.
messages.For an older or Full edit preset, Apply: For an older or Full edit preset, Apply mapped adjustments changes its included settings. Replace adjustment settings also resets adjustments, masks, Remove corrections, and geometry first. Replace keeps the crop and keeps Film unless the preset includes Film or you enable Turn Film off for the actions below.
messages.For four-star photos taken at 50mm in 20: For four-star photos taken at 50mm in 2026, set Rating to 4 stars and up, focal length minimum and maximum to 50, and capture dates from January 1 through December 31, 2026. Save those filters as a smart collection.
messages.For paper targets, choose whether to Sim: For paper targets, choose whether to Simulate paper and ink. Toggle Show out-of-gamut warning as needed.
messages.For small dust spots, enable Visualize S: For small dust spots, enable Visualize Spots and adjust Threshold to make edges easier to inspect.
messages.Generated masks undone · other edits ret: Generated masks undone · other edits retained
messages.Give tonal regions different color treat: Give tonal regions different color treatments and control how those treatments blend.
messages.Grain size multiplies the chosen stock’s: Grain size multiplies the chosen stock’s baseline particle area. The readout shows the resulting area in µm², so the same multiplier can show a different area after you change stocks.
messages.Group the rendered derivative with its s: Group the rendered derivative with its source in the catalog.
messages.Guides for your photographs, from first: Guides for your photographs, from first edit to export.
messages.HDR accepts 2–9 exposure-bracketed photo: HDR accepts 2–9 exposure-bracketed photos with matching dimensions. It aligns and exposure-fuses display-rendered frames to balance useful tones. Review moving subjects and edges for blending artifacts.
messages.HDR here is exposure fusion into a rende: HDR here is exposure fusion into a rendered TIFF. It does not produce a scene-linear RAW or DNG master.
messages.HEIF export requires the bundled macOS I: HEIF export requires the bundled macOS ImageIO helper
messages.Headline: Headline
messages.Healing copies spot positions and should: Healing copies spot positions and should only be transferred between photos with matching framing.

messages.History is stored in the catalog, so it: History is stored in the catalog, so it survives quitting. Undo and redo follow each photo during this session.
messages.Hold B to compare with the original, or: Hold B to compare with the original, or use Effects’ Reset to reset Texture, Clarity, Dehaze, and Vignette together.
messages.Hold B to show the original without Film: Hold B to show the original without Film, local masks, or finishing adjustments; release B to restore the edit. Slash (/) focuses photo search.
messages.Hold B to view the original without Film: Hold B to view the original without Film, local masks, or finishing adjustments. Release B to restore the edited view.
messages.Hold a mapped key and scroll or use arro: Hold a mapped key and scroll or use arrow keys.
messages.ISO, focal length in millimeters, apertu: ISO, focal length in millimeters, aperture f-number, and shutter time accept minimum and maximum values. Enter the same number at both ends for an exact match. Shutter time accepts seconds or a fraction such as 1/250. Photos without the required exposure metadata do not match.
messages.If Auto says it is waiting for the image: If Auto says it is waiting for the image preview, let the preview load and try again.
messages.If a merge reports an error, read the sp: If a merge reports an error, read the specific message and correct the input selection before trying again.
messages.If a photo cannot be rendered or display: If a photo cannot be rendered or displayed, the message in the photo area includes the reported reason when one is available. This can identify a missing file, an image-loading problem, or a graphics failure. If no reason is available, the message stays general.
messages.If a stock is unavailable, it may requir: If a stock is unavailable, it may require the GPU engine. Engine availability is shown in Settings → Performance.
messages.If an original is unavailable or has cha: If an original is unavailable or has changed, its recovery record is kept instead of being applied to a potentially different photo.
messages.If another application changes the same: If another application changes the same XMP property after the last read or sync, LightTable reports a conflict and leaves that sidecar unchanged. Review the external metadata, then import sidecars to accept those metadata values before making further changes in LightTable.
messages.If files are reported as cloud-only, dow: If files are reported as cloud-only, download them locally and scan again.
messages.If language loading or saving fails, you: If language loading or saving fails, your window and language selection stay available for another attempt. If pending photo edits could not save, use Retry save, then apply the language again.
messages.If local recovery finds outstanding chan: If local recovery finds outstanding changes when the library opens, Recover unsaved edits? lists the affected photos. Restore edits replaces their saved settings with the recovered settings. Keep saved edits keeps the catalog version and discards those recovery drafts.
messages.If masks cannot be transferred, copy aga: If masks cannot be transferred, copy again with Local masks unchecked to apply the other groups.
messages.If necessary, choose a different entry i: If necessary, choose a different entry in Lens profile and compare the correction against the original.
messages.If the 1:1 button’s tooltip reports a pr: If the 1:1 button’s tooltip reports a preview pixel size smaller than the source, you are seeing a smaller delivered preview. Auto resolution fits the display and increases its request for zoomed viewing; very large sources can exceed the preview request limit.
messages.If the Mac first-use choice cannot be sa: If the Mac first-use choice cannot be saved, Try Again retains the selection and retries. The app starts only after saving succeeds.
messages.If the primary system language is Englis: If the primary system language is English, English is saved automatically. Later launches use your saved choice. In a browser, the browser’s language preferences supply the initial suggestion.
messages.If the sidebar is hidden, use Show or hi: If the sidebar is hidden, use Show or hide library at the upper left.
messages.If the status says Edits not saved, use: If the status says Edits not saved, use Retry save. Keep the window open while a save is failing.
messages.If you restore, wait for saving to compl: If you restore, wait for saving to complete before closing the app.
messages.ImageIO did not create an output file: ImageIO did not create an output file

messages.Import from card copies files into the d: Import from card copies files into the destination you choose. The card originals stay in place.
messages.Import is still running. Use Jobs to che: Import is still running. Use Jobs to check its progress or cancel it.
messages.Import stopped. Any completed copies are: Import stopped. Any completed copies are kept; you can resume by importing again.
messages.Import stopped. Completed copies are saf: Import stopped. Completed copies are safe; run it again to continue.
messages.Import supported metadata and approximat: Import supported metadata and approximate edits, then review the conversion report.
messages.Import the originals from your Photos li: Import the originals from your Photos library.
messages.Importing the entire library needs full: Importing the entire library needs full Photos access. Allow access in System Settings, or choose individual photos instead.
messages.Imports LightTable, Lightroom/Camera Raw: Imports LightTable, Lightroom/Camera Raw XMP, and Capture One styles. In the Mac app, choose individual files or a whole preset folder.
messages.Improve preview speed and check image de: Improve preview speed and check image detail
messages.In Community, choose Featured, New, or A: In Community, choose Featured, New, or All and use Subject to narrow the collection. Select a preset to see its description, creator, version, Film behavior, and available example photos.
In Film profile, choose Film format.
messages.In Info, expand Description for title, c: In Info, expand Description for title, caption, and headline; Rights for creator, copyright, and credit; or Place for location and coordinates. Changes save to the catalog as you type. Open in Maps is available after this photo’s metadata loads and both latitude and longitude are valid. It opens the location in your browser.
messages.In Physical film stages, adjust Print gl: In Physical film stages, adjust Print glare, Print preflash, Yellow filter, and Magenta filter. Reopen the section if you collapsed it.
messages.In a grid, flag, rating, and colour-labe: In a grid, flag, rating, and colour-label actions apply to the selected set. In Detail, those marking actions apply to the active photo. In Survey, they apply to the active survey cell. Check the marking toolbar’s context before a batch action.
messages.In a grid, use the Size slider to change: In a grid, use the Size slider to change thumbnail size.
messages.In the Curve graph, the horizontal direc: In the Curve graph, the horizontal direction runs from darker input tones to brighter input tones. Moving a point up raises its output; moving it down lowers it. RGB adjusts the combined curve, while R, G, and B affect individual channels.
messages.In the desktop app, Add Photos opens a p: In the desktop app, Add Photos opens a picker for photos and folders. LightTable keeps the originals in their current location. Selecting an individual photo adds its containing folder, so other supported photos in that folder can appear too.
messages.Include Film profile and physical settin: Include Film profile and physical settings
messages.Includes the Film profile and physical s: Includes the Film profile and physical stages.
messages.Increase Dehaze to strengthen a hazy ima: Increase Dehaze to strengthen a hazy image, or try a negative value for a softer treatment. Check both contrast and color as you adjust it.
messages.Inspect Show Overlay and refine missed o: Inspect Show Overlay and refine missed or extra areas before adjusting Light or Color.
messages.Inspect at 1:1 and then return to Fit to: Inspect at 1:1 and then return to Fit to judge the overall result.
messages.Inspect detail at 1:1, apply ordinary de: Inspect detail at 1:1, apply ordinary detail controls, or run local learned denoise when available.
messages.Inspect each result. The operation updat: Inspect each result. The operation updates the relevant exposure control and limits the resulting adjustment to the supported range.
messages.Inspect the completion report for failed: Inspect the completion report for failed photos. A batch can finish with some photos changed and others left unchanged.
messages.Inspect the edges and final framing, the: Inspect the edges and final framing, then click Done.
messages.Inspect the image at 1:1 and wait for pr: Inspect the image at 1:1 and wait for preview detail to finish before judging texture.
messages.Inspect the overlay and use painted refi: Inspect the overlay and use painted refinements around boundaries as needed.
messages.Inspect the rejected photos. Check paire: Inspect the rejected photos. Check paired-file settings and expand any stacks if you expect to include their other members.
messages.Inspect the suggestions, then use Pick s: Inspect the suggestions, then use Pick selects or Reject rejects if you want to apply those flags.
messages.Interface controls the viewer background: Interface controls the viewer background, font scale, Lights Out, loupe information overlay, and crop guides. These preferences change the workspace appearance without changing exported pixels.
messages.It has stopped {count} times in a row (l:
It has stopped {count} times in a row (last status {status}). If the same photo was open each time, the next launch sets it aside automatically. Safe Mode opens the library with background services off so you can use Library Health to look for the cause.

The server log has the details.
messages.JPG (Large) uses full-size JPEG at quali: JPG (Large) uses full-size JPEG at quality 92 in sRGB. JPG (Small) uses a 2048-pixel long edge at quality 90 in sRGB. 16-bit TIFF uses full size and ProPhoto RGB. Changing these settings selects Custom.
messages.Judge sharpening and noise reduction at: Judge sharpening and noise reduction at 1:1. These controls work in both Film and Develop modes.
messages.Judge sharpening, noise reduction, and f: Judge sharpening, noise reduction, and film grain at 1:1 after detail has settled.
messages.Keep LightTable open. iCloud originals m: Keep LightTable open. iCloud originals may take a little longer.
messages.Keep Meter scene automatically enabled f: Keep Meter scene automatically enabled for automatic scene metering, or turn it off to set the capture exposure yourself.
messages.Keep Show Overlay enabled while checking: Keep Show Overlay enabled while checking the selected area, then turn it off to judge the photo.
messages.Keep a named group that updates from sup: Keep a named group that updates from supported rules as photo metadata changes.
messages.Keep alternate edits of one original and: Keep alternate edits of one original and collapse related photos in the grid.
messages.Keep automatic preview detail for normal: Keep automatic preview detail for normal editing. It follows the window size, display density, crop, and zoom without a pixel-size choice.

messages.Keep portable LightTable edits beside or: Keep portable LightTable edits beside originals
messages.Keep ratings, labels, keywords, rights,: Keep ratings, labels, keywords, rights, and compatible edits beside originals.

messages.Keyboard layout, direct slider control,: Keyboard layout, direct slider control, automation, and MIDI.

messages.Mask offers Subject, Sky, Object, Depth,: Mask offers Subject, Sky, Object, Depth, and People selections. These run locally; available methods depend on the selection type and platform.
messages.Mask pins and brush outlines stay sharp: Mask pins and brush outlines stay sharp and the same thickness as you zoom. The outline grows with the area it covers in the photo.
messages.Match total exposure uses the active pho: Match total exposure uses the active photo as its reference. When capture exposure metadata is available, it compares that information; otherwise it falls back to average image brightness. Review the result when scenes or lighting differ.
messages.Matte and Gloss in this interface are mo: Matte and Gloss in this interface are modeled paper previews; they are not a selection of your printer’s measured ICC profile. Treat the preview as guidance when comparing contrast and color.

messages.Missing exposure metadata does not match: Missing exposure metadata does not match an exposure filter. Rescan folders to index existing photos.
messages.Missing or invalid capture time can also: Missing or invalid capture time can also leave the export timestamp unchanged. Check Export details for the reported warning. A file’s filesystem timestamp is separate from the metadata policy selected above.
messages.Most settings changes save automatically: Most settings changes save automatically. Language uses Apply language and reloads the window after saving edits. General also controls Auto-advance after picking, rejecting, or rating, completion notifications, and update checks.

messages.On a new library, setup offers a local f: On a new library, setup offers a local folder, Lightroom migration, or Apple Photos. You can skip setup and add photos later.
messages.On first use, a non-English primary syst: On first use, a non-English primary system language prompts you to choose. messages.On macOS, Help → Diagnostics offers Relo: On macOS, Help → Diagnostics offers Reload Interface, Restart Rendering Service, Show Server Log, Library Health…, and Restart in Safe Mode.

messages.Open Info on the active photo. Enter key: Open Info on the active photo. Enter keywords in Add keywords and click Add to photo or press Enter. Commas separate keywords; Settings → Files & Metadata can also enable semicolon separators and catalog keyword suggestions.
messages.Open Info → On-device description to ins: Open Info → On-device description to inspect the current photo’s generated tags, visible text, and face count.

messages.Open Settings → Performance and expand A: Open Settings → Performance and expand Advanced.
